claim_summary: Channel 14's homepage counter stated that the number of 'terrorists we eliminated' was 3,600.
resolution_notes: State reconciliation: this claim is already canonical and Verified in the Sheet. False, narrowly on the numeric label. The IDF's contemporaneous Oct. 12 war diary said hundreds of terrorists had been killed while more than 3,600 targets had been attacked; Channel 14's own Oct. 12 article reported the same distinction correctly. The Seventh Eye contemporaneously preserves an exact screenshot of the Oct. 14 homepage counter labeling 3,600 as 'terrorists we eliminated.' Claim origin is a Channel 14 graphic/website counter, not a guest or panelist statement. No intent is inferred.
media_status: Exact claim-specific Channel 14 homepage screenshot is preserved in The Seventh Eye article as C14MED-2023-0008. Standalone exact image asset/stable GitHub preview remains Blocked; Notion publication was already completed and verified. No generic or related imagery used.
